doc.title: Zutty Singleton and Marge Singleton Interview, 1969-02-08

chapter: Marge Singleton's St. Louis memories of Jelly Roll
title: Nephew Frank, Uncle Don and learning rags
summary: Marge remembers the nephew Frank and Uncle Don, who could outplay Jelly. She mentions buying a rag book, and Zutty says he must learn the rags.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth
